title: Adjusting the Ground Truth Annotations for Connectivity-Based Learning to Delineate
mechanism: The annotated centerline is a snake (graph of vertices) that deforms during training toward the network's predicted distance map, regularized by elasticity and spring terms so it stays smooth and keeps its topology; the net trains on the distance map of the adjusted snake.
adaptation: 2D version: skeletonize crack labels to polylines, add a truncated-distance regression head to U-Net++, update snakes every N steps (SnakeFast) with displacement capped at 2 px, train the crack class on the adjusted snake redrawn at the source width.
min_experiment: Arm: house + distance head with snake-adjusted crack targets, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, relF1@2, components >= 20 px found. Kill: crack IoU below baseline by more than 0.012 and relF1@2 not up by 0.01.
evidence: R: on Brain, Neurons, MRA (10, 1, 31 training volumes) SnakeFast beats training on original annotations in APLS and TLTS, pixel quality about equal; degrades much more slowly as synthetic annotation deformation grows; beats NR-Dice, QAM, DS6 on topology metrics.
prior_overlap: none. Snakes listed as never tried; offset-tolerant CE did not move the labels.

alt_notes.adaptation: Skeletonise each crack label into a polyline graph, snake it toward the model's crack ridge (or the image's dark ridge) within 2 px every N steps, then redraw at each source's convention width (ARTS 1.5, CSIR/CFVS 1.75, BMRK 3.0, SDLE 3.25 px). Test labels stay unchanged, so gains may show in relF1@2 before strict IoU.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF trained on snake-adjusted crack labels vs PF, 5 seeds. Kill if relF1@2 gain < 0.01 and crack IoU change < +0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Skeletonise crack labels to polylines, run a snake toward the dark EL ridge or the model's ridge every N steps (max 2 px displacement), redraw at each source's convention width (ARTS 1.5, CFVS/CSIR 1.75, BMRK 3.0). Test labels stay unchanged, so relF1 may rise more than strict IoU. Doubles as a label-refinement tool for the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF trained on snake-adjusted crack labels, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF on revised labels. Metrics: clean-49 crack IoU, relF1@2, width. Kill if crack IoU < baseline - 0.012 and relF1@2 gain < 0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack mask -> skeleton -> polylines; each epoch move polylines up to 2 px toward the network's ridge (snake energy = network output + smoothness), rasterise at source width as the new target. Code is 3D; port to 2D.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm PF with snake-adjusted crack labels from epoch 25% onward vs PF; metric relF1@2 and strict IoU against original CV labels; kill if relF1@2 +<0.01 and strict IoU down >0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Convert crack masks to polylines, allow each to move within 2 px toward the network's predicted ridge each epoch, rasterise at source width. Model-driven version of ridge snapping.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm = PF with per-epoch polyline snapping (limit 2 px, start after 5k steps); baseline = PF; 5 seeds + 5-fold CV; metrics crack IoU on original labels, relF1@2, E1. Kill as for ridge snapping: IoU drop > 0.01 with no relF1@2 gain.
